summary.value: Live stream with Chris DeMars on TuxCare - started as a conversation about AI in content creation, ended up as a deep product overview of CKEditor AI: features, real-world use cases, and the architecture behind enterprise-grade AI content editing.

value.description: TuxCare Live: Chris and Ondřej Discuss CKEditor AI

content.value:
What we covered

TuxCare provides Long-Term Support as a service - keeping software, OSes, and runtimes alive beyond their official support windows with ongoing security patches. The audience is engineering teams running production systems that can't just upgrade on a vendor's schedule.

The conversation started with AI in content creation and quickly turned into a full CKEditor AI walkthrough - which made it one of the more thorough external product overviews I've done:

  • CKEditor AI features - AI Chat, AI Quick Actions, AI Review, and the integration model that makes them work inside any application.
  • Enterprise-grade architecture - how to hook CKEditor to your own LLM endpoint, stay behind your VPC, and avoid sending content to a public model.
  • Real-world use cases - where embedded AI beats standalone tools, and what it takes to go from a proof of concept to a production content workflow.
